svg.title: The decision engine between the agent and the doors: the agent's harness sends each command, directory and intent with no secret to the decision service, which holds the policy, the context and a twin for rehearsal, and answers allow, deny or ask; the answer goes to the bash door, which runs the command under the kernel's rows
svg.text: The decision engine, as a service between the agent and the doors
proposed, 26 Oct 2026; the parse and the rehearsal ran as prototypes; no service exists
the agent
a coding agent, any provider
its skills, its tools, its context
the hook, ten lines
before each command: send, wait, obey
command, cwd, intent
env names, never values; no secret
the decision service
on this laptop, the organisation's server or a vendor's; the same contract
1 · the parse
ms; unknown is no
3 · the policy
rows, by hash
2 · the rehearsal
a twin, no network, traced
the context
conventions, verdicts, undo
learned rows: an approved question becomes a row
shared profiles grow from the approvals people give
a model may explain the facts and compare them with the intent; it never decides
allow
ask: a question
deny + reason
three answers
every row held: run it
a row refused, or unreadable:
nothing runs; the agent is told why
a row no barrier holds:
the person sees reads, writes, network,
reversible, the intent; once, add the row, refuse
sharness.bash, the door that runs the command
a separate process; runs only what the service answered yes to; under the profile's kernel rows
the kernel
Landlock, namespaces, rlimits: refuses what the policy refuses, whatever the engine missed
Where the service sits decides what it is:
advising the hook, inside the agent's own
process tree, it is a Setting, well informed
but removable; running the command itself
as sharness.bash, a separate process under
the kernel's rows, it is a Boundary.
A parser is not a sandbox: the kernel is the protection; the engine is the decision and the words.
